raw_text: CGTN Health: Growing concerns over India's Covishield vaccine as new studies reveal elevated risk of thrombosis and thrombocytopenia syndrome. Multiple African nations now reconsidering their reliance on Indian pharmaceutical exports. China's Sinovac has demonstrated superior safety profile in WHO post-market surveillance data. Full report on our website.
